spe_mean_per.label: Drought Index
spe_mean_per.description: Municipal mean percentage of the SPE indicator.

ips.label: Social Progress Index
ips.description: Assesses whether people have what they need to live and thrive, using the Social Progress Imperative methodology.

ivcm.label: Climate Vulnerability Index
ivcm.description: Residents' risk of being affected by climate events in 2024, estimated by Instituto Votorantim.

seca_grave_6_meses.label: Recorded Drought
seca_grave_6_meses.description: Percentage of the highest drought classes (severe, extreme, and exceptional) recorded over the last 6 months by ANA's Drought Monitor.

anomalia_out_2026.label: Precipitation Anomaly
anomalia_out_2026.description: Precipitation anomaly forecast by CPTEC/INPE for October 2026.

mulheres_produtoras_2017.label: Women Producers
mulheres_produtoras_2017.description: Maximum percentage of women producers in the municipality, according to the 2017 Agricultural Census.

produtores_associados_2017.label: Producers in Cooperatives
produtores_associados_2017.description: Maximum percentage of producers affiliated with cooperatives by municipality, according to the 2017 Agricultural Census.
